title: The Magical Mystery
subtitle: A Magician’s Illusion Turns Into Danger
summary: When Feluda, his cousin, and their quirky friend attend a magician’s show in Calcutta, an innocent evening of tricks and hypnotism takes a sinister turn. With his sharp mind and knowledge of magic, Feluda must unravel the secrets behind the spectacle—before the real danger escapes the stage. Dive into a world where every illusion hides a clue, and nothing is as it seems.
